{{short description|None}}

{{Use dmy dates|date=August 2022}}{{2016 Summer Olympics}}

This is a chronological summary of the medal events of the [[2016 Summer Olympics]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]], Brazil. With 306 sets of medals, the games featured 28 [[Olympic sports]], including [[rugby sevens]] and [[golf]], which were added to the Olympic program in 2009. These sporting events took place at 33 venues in the host city, and at five in [[São Paulo]], [[Belo Horizonte]], [[Salvador, Bahia|Salvador]], [[Brasília]], and [[Manaus]].

Due to the [[European migrant crisis]] and other reasons, the [[International Olympic Committee]] (IOC) allowed athletes to compete under the [[Olympic Flag]] as part of the "[[Refugee Olympic Team at the 2016 Summer Olympics|Refugee Olympic Team]]" (ROT); out of 43 refugee athletes deemed potentially eligible, 10 were chosen to form this team.<ref name="BBC-ROA">{{cite news |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/olympics/35710578 |title=Rio 2016: Refugee team to compete at Olympics |accessdate=3 March 2016 |publisher=BBC Sport}}</ref> Due to the suspension of the National Olympic Committee of Kuwait, participants from Kuwait were allowed to participate under the Olympic Flag as "[[Independent Olympic Athletes at the 2016 Summer Olympics|Independent Olympic Athletes]]" (IOA).<ref name="guardian-yuliya2">{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2016/jul/01/russian-whistleblower-yulia-stepanova-cleared-neutral-athlete-rio|title=Russian whistleblower Yuliya Stepanova to compete as 'neutral athlete' in Rio|website=The Guardian|date=July 2016 |accessdate=15 July 2016 |last1=Ingle |first1=Sean }}</ref>
